answer: Cap each identity at 10 paid submissions per epoch, enforced at the jetty checkpoint by auditors drawn fresh each epoch. Auditors cannot review identities sharing their funding source, and the willow ledger publishes every decision for rechecking in seconds. Each identity posts a 25 POA deposit locked 30 epochs, 100% slashed when an auditor proves duplication. One fake costs 25 POA at risk for at most 10 capped payments; 1,000 fakes cost 25,000 POA locked across 1,000 audit queues, and an ember flag on any clone freezes its cluster's unpaid balance until re-audit clears it.
